name: veristack
description: Deterministic 9-rung zero-defect verification ladder, push-down analyzer, formal checks, and BYO System 1 circuits for TypeScript, C#, Rust, and Python.

scripts.test:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path templates/rust-reference/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path templates/rust-reference/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path templates/rust-reference/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:python: uv run --project templates/python-reference ruff check templates/python-reference && uv run --project templates/python-reference ruff format --check templates/python-reference && uv run --project templates/python-reference mypy templates/python-reference/src templates/python-reference/tests && uv run --project templates/python-reference pytest templates/python-reference
scripts.check: bun run lint:no-comments && bun run lint:state-machines && bun test ./tests/ && bun src/cli.ts scan . --fail-on-cheats
